name: FreshRSS
param_style: PHP PDO, `?` positional and `:name`; entry list / mark-read / archiving SQL concatenated at runtime from options and the parsed search expression
data_scale: scale 1: 20 categories, 300 feeds, 100k entries over ~70 days (10 heavy feeds, ~22% unread), 15 labels, ~27k label links, 2k staged entrytmp rows
visibility_note: 16k stars, the most-deployed self-hosted RSS reader; SQLite is the default for single-user and small installs
interest_note: Entry list = top-N id subquery joined back to entry (late row lookup) with keyset OR-predicates and LIKE searches; per-feed archiving DELETE with three derived-table OFFSET/MAX subqueries; staged-entry commit via INSERT OR IGNORE … SELECT; CTE-fed correlated UPDATE of cached counts.
reach_note: widely self-hosted feed reader; SQLite supported natively
